archive.catalogue_description: Features: Nova crawlers (teleporting, EMP, jumping, kamikazes) Juggernaut Bosses BO1 Perks + Ammomatic + Electric Cherry + Widows Wine Buildable Zombie Shield Buildable Sliquifier Baby Gun Galvaknuckles Sidestepping/Barrel rolling zombies Super sprinters Zombie Cash, Zombie Blood, Death Machine and Random gun drops Crawling when downed in Co-op Shangri La Geyser Weapons List: Pistols – MR6 RK5 (Akimbo & Single Wield) Executioner Five Seven (Akimbo) Desert Eagle (Akimbo) RE45 (Akimbo) SMGs – MP5 ASM1 PDW Skorpion EVO AK12 Vesper Weevil ARs/Rifles – AUG M16A1 SMR Scar H Galil M8A1 FN FAL AN94 MK14 G2A4 XR2 KN44 M8A7 ICR-1 Snipers – DSR Drakon LMGs – LSAT HAMR RPD M27-IAR Shotguns – Remington 870 KSG Bulldog Haymaker 12 Wunderweapons – Gershes QEDs Ray Gun Ray Gun Mark 2 31-79 JGb215 (Baby Gun) Sliquifier Misc – Zombie Shield Galvaknuckles Claymores Credits: Bluntstuffy RadimaX AwesomePieman redspace offthewall Tito YaPhil Ege115 Ronan Merriman Pro FTW JBird632 Addicted Make Cents HarryBO21 Seth Norris Pro Revenge Jiffy Noodles CHN Tom BMX Rollonmath Hitmanvere A Few Things: Rounds starting immediately is intentional as it speeds up the gameplay. PHD will protect you from all Nova/EMP explosions except ‘Kamikazes’ (and you won’t lose your perks if hit by one) You can only have one wonder weapon at a time, and if you’re currently holding one you won’t see another in the box. Juggernauts are not affected by the Sliquifier or Baby Gun. Novas don’t spawn until the power is turned on

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
